# netcup_clouddns_domains (Data Source)

All domains of the netcup API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netcup_clouddns_domains" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `domains` (Attributes List) Domains of the API key. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domains))

<a id="nestedatt--domains"></a>
### Nested Schema for `domains`

Read-Only:

- `fqdn` (String) Domain name.
- `id` (Number) Id of the domain.
- `is_dns_managed` (Boolean) The `isDnsManaged` value of the netcup API.
